{"language":"python","code":"
FONT = [
0xF0,0x90,0x90,0x90,0xF0,  # 0
0x20,0x60,0x20,0x20,0x70,  # 1
0xF0,0x10,0xF0,0x80,0xF0,  # 2
0xF0,0x10,0xF0,0x10,0xF0,  # 3
0x90,0x90,0xF0,0x10,0x10,  # 4
0xF0,0x80,0xF0,0x10,0xF0,  # 5
0xF0,0x80,0xF0,0x90,0xF0,  # 6
0xF0,0x10,0x20,0x40,0x40,  # 7
0xF0,0x90,0xF0,0x90,0xF0,  # 8
0xF0,0x90,0xF0,0x10,0xF0,  # 9
0xF0,0x90,0xF0,0x90,0x90,  # A
0xE0,0x90,0xE0,0x90,0xE0,  # B
0xF0,0x80,0x80,0x80,0xF0,  # C
0xE0,0x90,0x90,0x90,0xE0,  # D
0xF0,0x80,0xF0,0x80,0xF0,  # E
0xF0,0x80,0xF0,0x80,0x80,  # F
]

class Chip8:
    def __init__(self, rom):
        self.mem = bytearray(4096)
        self.mem[0x050:0x050+80] = bytes(FONT)
        self.mem[0x200:0x200+len(rom)] = bytes(rom)
        self.V = [0]*16
        self.I = 0
        self.pc = 0x200
        self.stack = []
        self.dt = 0
        self.st = 0
        self.gfx = [[0]*64 for _ in range(32)]
        self.keys = [False]*16
        self.awaiting_key = None  # reg waiting for Fx0A
        self.crash = None

    def keypress(self, k):
        # one-shot press for Fx0A
        self.keys[k] = True
        if self.awaiting_key is not None:
            self.V[self.awaiting_key] = k
            self.awaiting_key = None
            return True
        return False

    def step(self):
        if self.crash: return
        if self.pc >= 0xFFF:
            self.crash = f"PC out of range {self.pc:#x}"
            return
        op = (self.mem[self.pc] << 8) | self.mem[self.pc+1]
        self.pc = (self.pc + 2) & 0xFFF
        self.exec(op)
        if self.dt > 0: self.dt -= 1
        if self.st > 0: self.st -= 1

    def exec(self, op):
        nnn = op & 0xFFF; n = op & 0xF; x = (op >> 8) & 0xF; y = (op >> 4) & 0xF
        kk = op & 0xFF; V = self.V
        h = op >> 12
        if h == 0x0:
            if op == 0x00E0: self.gfx = [[0]*64 for _ in range(32)]
            elif op == 0x00EE:
                if not self.stack: self.crash="stack underflow"; return
                self.pc = self.stack.pop()
            elif op == 0x00E1: self.pc = self.V[x]  # rare, ignore-ish
            elif nnn == 0x0nn: pass  # 128/voxas
            else: pass  # sys/unknown
        elif h == 0x1: self.pc = nnn
        elif h == 0x2:
            if len(self.stack) >= 16: self.crash="stack overflow"; return
            self.stack.append(self.pc); self.pc = nnn
        elif h == 0x3:
            if V[x] == kk: self.pc = (self.pc+2) & 0xFFF
        elif h == 0x4:
            if V[x] != kk: self.pc = (self.pc+2) & 0xFFF
        elif h == 0x5:
            if V[x] == V[y]: self.pc = (self.pc+2) & 0xFFF
        elif h == 0x6: V[x] = kk
        elif h == 0x7: V[x] = (V[x]+kk) & 0xFF
        elif h == 0x8:
            if n == 0: V[x] = V[y]
            elif n == 1: V[x] = V[x] | V[y]; V[0xF] = 0
            elif n == 2: V[x] = V[x] & V[y]; V[0xF] = 0
            elif n == 3: V[x] = V[x] ^ V[y]; V[0xF] = 0
            elif n == 4:
                s = V[x]+V[y]; V[0xF] = 1 if s > 255 else 0; V[x] = s & 0xFF
            elif n == 5:
                b = 1 if V[x] >= V[y] else 0; V[x] = (V[x]-V[y]) & 0xFF; V[0xF] = b
            elif n == 6:
                vf = V[x] & 1; V[x] = V[x] >> 1; V[0xF] = vf
            elif n == 7:
                b = 1 if V[x] <= V[y] else 0; V[x] = (V[y]-V[x]) & 0xFF; V[0xF] = b
            elif n == 0xE:
                vf = (V[x] >> 7) & 1; V[x] = (V[x] << 1) & 0xFF; V[0xF] = vf
        elif h == 0x9:
            if V[x] != V[y]: self.pc = (self.pc+2) & 0xFFF
        elif h == 0xA: self.I = nnn
        elif h == 0xB: self.pc = (nnn + V[0]) & 0xFFF
        elif h == 0xC:
            import random
            V[x] = random.randint(0,255) & kk
        elif h == 0xD:
            sx = V[x] & 63; sy = V[y] & 31; collision = 0
            for row in range(n):
                if sx + row > 31 and not (row >= 32): pass
                bits = self.mem[(self.I + row) & 0xFFF]
                for col in range(8):
                    if bits & (0x80 >> col):
                        px = (sx+col) & 63; py = (sy+row) & 31
                        if self.gfx[py][px]: collision = 1
                        self.gfx[py][px] ^= 1
            V[0xF] = collision
        elif h == 0xE:
            if kk == 0x9E:
                if self.keys[V[x]]: self.pc = (self.pc+2) & 0xFFF
            elif kk == 0xA1:
                if not self.keys[V[x]]: self.pc = (self.pc+2) & 0xFFF
        elif h == 0xF:
            if kk == 0x07: V[x] = self.dt
            elif kk == 0x0A:
                pressed = [i for i in range(16) if self.keys[i]]
                if pressed: V[x] = pressed[0]
                else: self.awaiting_key = x; self.pc -= 2
            elif kk == 0x15: self.dt = V[x]
            elif kk == 0x18: self.st = V[x]
            elif kk == 0x1E: self.I = (self.I + V[x]) & 0xFFF
            elif kk == 0x29: self.I = V[x] * 5  # font at 0x050
            elif kk == 0x33:
                self.mem[self.I] = V[x]//100
                self.mem[self.I+1] = (V[x]//10)%10
                self.mem[self.I+2] = V[x]%10
            elif kk == 0x55:
                for i in range(x+1): self.mem[self.I+i] = V[i]
            elif kk == 0x65:
                for i in range(x+1): V[i] = self.mem[self.I+i]
        else:
            self.crash = f"bad op {op:#06x} at {self.pc-2:#x}"

    def screen(self):
        return "\n".join("".join("#" if p else "." for p in row) for row in self.gfx)
"}
